_comment: DEC-5 (docs/designs/gated-pipeline-master-2026-08-03.md §3) as data, per
REQ-B9/G3 (design §4). 'Review-set per change class' -- never a prose
flip (the HR-F7 rule: every flip/demotion condition lives in data a
check reads, not in a comment an operator has to remember to act on).
Consumed by adapters/claude-code/hooks/review-record-push-gate.sh's
class-gate extension (Task 18). Classes are matched against a pushed
path in ARRAY ORDER -- FIRST MATCH WINS. A path matching none of these
globs is UNCLASSIFIED and is not touched by the class-gate extension at
all (the pre-existing per-blob rrg_is_covered coverage check, if
rrg_in_surface flags the path, still applies completely unchanged --
this table is additive, never a replacement for that mechanism).
glob syntax: bash case-pattern globs (the SAME convention
review-record-gate-lib.sh's rrg_in_surface uses) -- a bare `*` already
matches across `/`, and consecutive `*` characters collapse to the same
match (POSIX fnmatch), so `**` here is written for human readability
and behaves identically to a single `*`. Matched against the
REPO-ROOT-RELATIVE path.
required_reviews[] tokens (see review-record-push-gate.sh's
_rrpg_reviewer_required_satisfied / _rrpg_harness_review_satisfied /
_rrpg_evidence_present_this_push for exactly how each token is
verified):
'harness'    -- satisfied iff the class's pushed paths all have the
PRE-EXISTING per-blob review-record-push-gate.sh
coverage (docs/reviews/records/index.json or
grandfather-manifest.json, kind=harness-change-review,
verdict=PASS). Reuses that mechanism outright -- it is
the harness reviewer's own trust root; this table
does not re-implement it.
'evidence'   -- satisfied iff this push's own commit range adds or
modifies at least one docs/plans/*evidence* artifact
(the plan Closure Contract convention already used
throughout docs/plans/).
any other token (e.g. 'architecture-reviewer', 'harness-reviewer',
'plan-fidelity-reviewer', 'code-reviewer') -- taken
as a REVIEWER AGENT TYPE: satisfied iff at least one
review-record file exists under docs/reviews/** AS OF
the local sha being pushed (git grep + git show
against local_sha, never the working tree -- same-
push honoring, the gate's existing ref-based-read
precedent) whose **Reviewer:** base token
(review-chain-lib.sh's rc_record_reviewer /
rc__base_token, reused verbatim) equals the token and
whose final ## Verdict:/## Delta Verdict: heading
(rc_record_verdict, reused verbatim) is PASS-shaped
(PASS | SOUND | SOUND-WITH-AMENDMENTS).
architecture_trigger_globs (harness class only): the 'if-triggered'
qualifier on the architecture-reviewer requirement -- that token is
only evaluated (and can only appear in a class's missing-reviews list)
when at least one of THIS push's harness-class paths also matches one
of these globs. Narrower than the whole harness surface on purpose:
architecture review is expensive (design §11, ~10-15 min/review) and
the design's own §11 cost model assumes it does not fire on every
harness-class push -- only on the surfaces where a wrong shape is
expensive to unwind (gate/lib/agent/config surfaces), not on every
doc-comment or fixture edit under adapters/claude-code/**.
posture:
'exempt'            -- never checked, never logged, passes silently.
'warn'               -- missing required review(s) always WARN, never
block, regardless of flip_date (flip_date is
null for every warn-posture class below --
an operator sets one once a would-have-
blocked baseline justifies it, per M-6).
'block-after-date'   -- WARN before flip_date (calibration window,
unset/future flip_date == still calibrating,
the same convention review-chain-lib.sh's
RC_ANCHOR_CALIBRATION_END_DATE uses), BLOCK
on/after flip_date.
would-have-blocked baseline (M-6, measured 2026-08-03 over the last 30
days of real push history on origin/master via git-log path
classification + as-of-that-commit review-record search -- METHODOLOGY
NOTE: this table itself did not exist before this commit, so the
baseline necessarily applies TODAY's class definitions retroactively to
historical commits' changed-path sets and historical review-record
presence, not a literal replay of this gate's as-of-local-sha config
read; see the Task 18 build report for the exact command and the
per-class counts):
harness       : see per-class baseline_note below.
other-docs    : see per-class baseline_note below.
product       : see per-class baseline_note below.
provenance-docs: exempt by design -- never measured, never gated.

classes.baseline_note: golden: P-40 (an unreviewed harness change reaching the remote). Pre-flip_date: refused-in-warn-form -- a full {WHAT/WHY/FIX/ESCAPE} message naming the missing required review(s), printed to stderr, but the push is NOT blocked (rc unaffected by this check alone). On/after flip_date: BLOCK (rc=1) unless a fresh operator override marker covers the exact sha. would-have-blocked baseline (30-day origin/master history, harness-class-touching non-merge commits, checked for a same-or-earlier architecture-reviewer/harness-reviewer record + an evidence-artifact touch in the SAME commit): see the Task 18 build report for the measured count and rate -- recorded here as a comment, not a flip condition, per the HR-F7 rule (only flip_date drives behavior).

the pipeline never gates its own provenance artifacts (DEC-5; arch-M2's circularity concern -- a review record IS a provenance artifact, so gating docs/reviews/** on 'has this been reviewed' is self-referential by construction). Never measured; not a candidate for any future flip.

catches everything under docs/** not already claimed by provenance-docs above (array order = precedence, so provenance-docs paths never reach this arm). Own flip condition is null until a would-have-blocked baseline is measured over a calibration week of real push history (M-6) -- an operator sets flip_date here once that baseline justifies it; until then this NEVER blocks, only WARNs. would-have-blocked baseline (30-day origin/master history): see the Task 18 build report.

product-repo changes (neural-lace/workstreams-ui/** etc.). Requires a measured would-have-blocked rate before any flip_date is set (DEC-5) -- an operator sets flip_date here once that baseline justifies it; until then this NEVER blocks, only WARNs. would-have-blocked baseline (30-day origin/master history): see the Task 18 build report.
